title: Dir(1, 1, 1) plus counts (5, 3, 2)
caption: Adding the counts to the prior parameters gives Dir(6, 4, 3), total 13; the posterior mean of p₁ is its share, 6/13 ≈ 0.46.
alt: A single bar split into three parts of sizes 6, 4 and 3, for p₁, p₂ and p₃, total 13.
description: The posterior mean of each pᵢ is its parameter over the total 13; for p₁ that is 6/13.
